scoring_dimensions.reasoning: Low criticality: analytics/reporting platform, not revenue-critical
RHEL 7, Python 3.9, Tomcat 6.1, and PostgreSQL 13 are all EOL
3-Tier architecture; already containerized; has CI/CD pipeline
8 API endpoints and 3 external interfaces — manageable
Single server; cloud-hosted on AWS; 200 GB database

key_risk_factors: All 4 technology components are EOL — comprehensive upgrade required
Tomcat 6.1 EOL since 2016 — severe vulnerability exposure
modernization_recommendation: Medium urgency. Despite low business criticality, all components are EOL creating significant security risk. Upgrade stack: OS to RHEL 9, Python to 3.12, Tomcat to 10.x, PostgreSQL to 16. Containerization already in place simplifies this.
